review_kind: AI-assisted semantic audit; not a human agronomy, logistics, market, accounting, or ML-expert review
method: Decomposed every final response into independently checkable qualitative assertions.
Compared universal and comparative claims against all frozen strategy/policy/order/allocation records, not only model-selected references.
Used one authenticated GET of the immutable V9 scenario to inspect full baseline/result allocations; retained only aggregate crop-count evidence and no credential.
Kept semantic status separate from application reference validation and automated phrase scoring.

summary.automated_quality_status: FAIL: 12 PASS / 6 FAIL; four failures are conservative keyword/prefix false negatives and two are real abstention contract failures
summary.acceptance_impact: The V9 mission was accepted for simulation although its required Supply finding contained a false full-booked-fulfillment premise. Numerical strategy metrics remain internally reproducible, but the qualitative Council gate did not establish semantic correctness.

recorded_nonfinal_attempts.statement: Across the three strategies, the frozen plans leave unfilled demand and projected disposed quantity nonzero, while each booked order is fully delivered and no declared hard-constraint violation is reported. Per-order routing feasibility therefore does not imply complete demand coverage; the recipe timing constraint means new sowing cannot meet an earlier delivery.
recorded_nonfinal_attempts.finding: The same false every-booked-order assertion appeared before format repair. It was rejected only for a model-authored number word.

global_limits: AI-assisted review can detect record contradictions and missing support but is not an independent human expert assessment.
Synthetic model consistency does not establish agronomic realism, causal validity, market validity, profitability, logistics feasibility, or safe real-farm action.
A selected typed reference verifies membership/value rendering, not that prose follows from it.
The phrase scorer is intentionally conservative and is neither a semantic oracle nor a substitute for reviewing full frozen context.
The authenticated allocation read was GET-only; no provider call, calculation, deployment or farm mutation was performed.
